_note: Tool Belt stage 1: one signature move per kata for the KATA button, from drafts/content/tool-belt-stage-1.md (Jay: 'Draft is OK', Nov 24). kata and requirement must match content/katas (a test checks). Every enemy within radius (tiles) of the hero takes a hit of this strength (a share of Power, like a Strike's 2.5), is pushed knockTiles away (bosses stay put) and is stunned staggerTicks (capped by COMBAT.counter.holdCapTicks). cooldownTicks: 20 = 1 second. anim = hero motion (stand-in until new art).

moves.name: Kiai!
moves.text: A huge KIAI stuns everyone close and pushes them back a little.

moves.name: Four Corners
moves.text: Blocks and front kicks to all four sides knock everyone far back.

moves.name: Iron Wall
moves.text: Every block, then a mighty reverse punch that blasts everyone close.
